posts.title: Gig Announcement: Badass Bitches & Queers Presents QWIM September Banger 19th of September at Blue Moon Cambridge
posts.description: We are so excited to be invited to Cambridge to play QWIM! There are a whole host of different bands and acts there so there’s something for everyone. You can use the QR code to get your ticket and we will see you there!!

posts.title: Mega Road Trip And A Manchester Debut Ft. The Raging Mabels And Swole Castrati
posts.description: A very delayed post but better late than never! Back in July we had our last gig before the summer and boy was it a great one. It marked our first time visiting Manchester and also our first excursion up north. We love meeting new bands and playing new venues so it was a no brainer when Harley from Leaf Promotions asked us to play at Grand Central in Manchester. Promotion for the gig was excellent

posts.title: The Star In Shoreditch with Life Review, Reliant, Mark Velvet, Them Nudes, The Space
posts.description: It was a busy weekend for us as we travelled down to London last Saturday for our gig at The Star in Shoreditch. We knew going into this gig that things would be a bit different to the kind of shows we usually play.
